classification.difficultyReason: Choose which end faces, curved portions and cut rectangles remain for each stated opening. The closed quarter-cylinder requires combining two quarter-circle ends, quarter curved area and two full cut rectangles.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of the following solids to the nearest whole number.

spec.description: Horizontal cylinder with open left end and closed right end; unshaded black outlines.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=15\div2=7.5\text{ cm}$.

One circular end and the curved surface:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\&=\pi(7.5)^2+2\pi(7.5)(25)\\&=431.25\pi\\&\approx1355\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Open-top trough with two closed semicircular ends, centre dots and dashed hidden rear rim.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=1.5\div2=0.75\text{ m}$.

Two semicircular ends and half the curved surface:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=2\left(\frac12\pi r^2\right)+\frac12(2\pi rh)\\&=\pi(0.75)^2+\pi(0.75)(2.4)\\&=2.3625\pi\\&\approx7\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Closed half-cylinder with curved surface uppermost and flat rectangular base; hidden rear diameter and base edge dashed.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=2.8\div2=1.4\text{ m}$.

Two semicircular ends, half the curved surface and the base rectangle:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\pi r^2+\pi rh+2rh\\&=\pi(1.4)^2+\pi(1.4)(4.6)+(2.8)(4.6)\\&=8.4\pi+12.88\\&\approx39\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Oblique cylinder with both circular ends open and hidden far rim dashed.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=8\div2=4\text{ cm}$.

Only the curved surface remains:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=2\pi rh\\&=2\pi(4)(36)\\&=288\pi\\&\approx905\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$

children.prompt: Half cylinder with open top, one end open

spec.description: Open-top trough, open near end and closed far semicircular end; no diameter line across the open near end.
spec.mathematics: Length 4.5 m; diameter 2.2 m; far diameter centre marked.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=2.2\div2=1.1\text{ m}$.

One semicircular end and half the curved surface:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\frac12\pi r^2+\pi rh\\&=\frac12\pi(1.1)^2+\pi(1.1)(4.5)\\&=5.555\pi\\&\approx17\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

children.label: f
children.prompt: Half-cylinder with open top, open both ends

spec.description: Half-cylinder shell with open top and both ends open; open rim slits retained.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=19\div2=9.5\text{ cm}$.

Only half the curved surface remains:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\frac12(2\pi rh)\\&=\pi(9.5)(42)\\&=399\pi\\&\approx1253\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Closed quarter-cylinder with two rectangular side faces, quarter-circular ends, equal-radius double ticks, both right-angle marks and dashed hidden rear radii and longitudinal corner.

answer.worked:
Two quarter-circle ends, one quarter of the curved surface and two side rectangles:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=2\left(\frac14\pi r^2\right)+\frac14(2\pi rh)+2rh\\&=\frac12\pi(6)^2+\frac12\pi(6)(10)+2(6)(10)\\&=48\pi+120\\&\approx271\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Open-top half-cylinder with two closed semicircular ends and dashed hidden far semicircular edge.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=1.6\div2=0.8\text{ m}$.

Two semicircular ends and half the curved surface:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\pi r^2+\pi rh\\&=\pi(0.8)^2+\pi(0.8)(2)\\&=2.24\pi\\&\approx7\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Closed half-cylinder with flat rectangular face uppermost and dashed hidden near semicircular edge.

answer.worked:
Radius: $r=5\div2=2.5\text{ cm}$.

Two semicircular ends, half the curved surface and the top rectangle:
$$\begin{aligned}SA&=\pi r^2+\pi rh+2rh\\&=\pi(2.5)^2+\pi(2.5)(4)+(5)(4)\\&=16.25\pi+20\\&\approx71\text{ cm}^2\end{aligned}$$
